templates.name: Burn Down
templates.description: Drive a count to zero, such as lint warnings, type errors, TODOs or deprecated calls. Retries in fresh sessions until the count command prints 0, then makes sure the tests still pass.
templates.author: nhickster

templates.name: Green Build
templates.description: Format, then lint, typecheck and test, with an AI fix step behind each check. A fix step runs only when its check fails, so an already green branch costs no AI turns.
templates.author: nhickster

templates.name: Review Branch
templates.description: Review the current branch against its base, fix what the review finds, and keep the tests passing.
templates.author: nhickster

templates.name: Second Opinion Review
templates.description: Three harnesses review the branch in parallel without editing anything. A fourth step merges their findings, fixes the real problems, and keeps the tests passing.
templates.author: nhickster

templates.name: Update Agent Instructions
templates.description: Create or update the instruction files AI coding agents read (Copilot instructions, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), one file per area of the codebase. You approve the split, parallel steps write the files, and a review pass ties them together and commits.
templates.author: nhickster
